question: In which year did the Federal Court of India start functioning?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1937**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __**__Key Poi__nts**

__
 
• **Federal Court of India:-**

 
 
• Under the terms of the Government of India Act of 1935, the Federal Court of India was a judicial body with original, appellate, and advisory jurisdiction that was founded in India in **1937**.
 
• Despite the Federal Court's location in Delhi, it continued operations until the **Supreme Court of India **was founded in 1950.
 
• In order to settle disagreements between provinces as well as between the center and the provinces, a federal court was established in** Delhi**.
 
• No more than** six justices** and **one Chief Justice** were to serve.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Supreme Court was established on **January 28, 1950**, two days after India became the Sovereign Democratic Republic.
 
• The Council of States and the House of the People of India's Parliament, which is housed in the same structure as the inauguration, meet in the **Chamber of Princes**.
 
• The Federal Court of India has met here, in this Chamber of Princes, for 12 years, from **1937 to 1950**.
 
• This would serve as the** Supreme Court's** residence for years to come until it moved into its current location.
 
• The inaugural ceremonies were understated yet **magnificent**.
